name: shadow_pipeline_builder
description: Takes the project building footprint and the surrounding context mesh (from Shadow Context Builder) and assembles the No-Action and With-Action scenes for CEQR incremental shadow analysis. Also configures CEQR-compliant analysis dates and time windows.

building_geojson.description: Project building footprint (GeoJSON). Used to extrude the project building mesh.

project_location.description: [lat, lon] of project centroid. Inherited from Shadow Context Builder. Auto-derived from building_geojson if not provided.

context_mesh_obj.description: No-Action surrounding building massing (OBJ). Inherited from Shadow Context Builder. If omitted, With-Action scene contains only the project building.

study_area_radius_ft.description: Study area radius in feet — passed through from Shadow Context Builder.

analysis_dates.description: List of ISO date strings to analyze (e.g. ['2024-12-21', '2024-03-21']). Defaults to CEQR NYC standard: Dec 21, Mar 21, May 6, Jun 21.

project_mesh_obj.description: OBJ of project building alone. Origin at project centroid. Metres, Z-up, +Y=North. Feed into shadow-incremental as project_mesh_obj.

no_action_mesh_obj.description: No-Action scene OBJ (= context_mesh_obj passthrough). Feed into shadow-incremental.

with_action_mesh_obj.description: With-Action scene OBJ: context + project building combined. Feed into shadow-incremental.

building_height_ft.description: Project height in feet — passed through.

study_area_radius_ft.description: Study area radius in feet — passed through.

analysis_dates.description: Analysis date strings (CEQR standard or user-specified).

analysis_year.description: Calendar year used for solar calculations (current year).

visualization.description: Folium map showing the project building footprint with height label.
